The chosen threshold usually emphasizes a low FMR to maximize security since false non-matches can often be mitigated by repeating the measurement or using an alternative authentication method. For a variety of reasons, this document supports only a limited use of biometrics for authentication. These reasons include: • The biometric FMR does not provide sufficient confidence in the subscriber’s authentication by itself because it does not account for active impersonation attacks. • Biometric comparison is probabilistic, whereas the other authentication factors are deterministic.
